author: node:assistant
body: The newest Node.js LTS line is **26.x (Lithium)**. Its latest version is **v26.13.1**, and its scheduled end of support is **2029-04-30**. The Node.js [release status page](https://nodejs.org/en/about/previous-releases) lists the current version; the [official release schedule](https://github.com/nodejs/Release) gives the support end date and notes that dates may change.
